SELECT category, COUNT(category)
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(category) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(category) DESC

SELECT category, COUNT(category)
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(category) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(category) DESC category ASC

SELECT category, COUNT(category)
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(category) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(category) DESC, category ASC

SELECT category, MAX(price)
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING MAX(price) > 10000
ORDER BY category ASC;
